'''Landing bay X23''' was [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]].<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
 
==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Get them aboard. Popara expects us.|Vago, to H-3POB, at landing bay X23 in ''Tempest Feud'', part of a sequence of events that conflicts with ''Scourge''|<ref name="Tempest Feud" />}}
Landing bay X23 appeared in the [[2002]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Tempest Feud]]'', by [[Jeff Grubb]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens]]. Landing bay X23 is located on the world that is the starting location for the roleplaying adventure, which can be any world in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] or [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], at the discretion of the gamemaster. Locating the landing bay on a world in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] is recommended while it is specified that the hangar should not be placed on a world sited in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] or [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
 
In ''Tempest Feud'', the player characters are summoned to perform an assignment for the Hutt  [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]] and rendezvous at landing bay X23 with Popara's representative [[Vago Gejalli Thokka]] and the protocol droid [[H-3POB]]. The group then board a [[Seltiss-2 caravel|Hutt caravel]], for transport to Popara's [[Yacht/Legends|space yacht]] ''[[Imru Ootmian]]''. After meeting with Popara and being briefed on a mission to the quarantined world [[Endregaad]], the player characters return with Vago to landing bay X23.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
 
In the [[2012]] novel [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']], an adaptation of ''Tempest Feud'' written by Jeff Grubb, the Jedi Master [[Mander Zuma]], spacer [[Reen Irana]] and smuggler [[Eddey Be'ray]] fulfill the equivalent role of the player characters in ''Tempest Feud''. The novel depicts the trio's meeting with Vago for transport to the ''Imru Ootmian'' playing out differently, with the rendezvous taking place at the hangar [[berth Y-27]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], not at landing bay X23. It is therefore assumed that under the official course of events in [[Star Wars Legends|Star Wars ''Legends'']] continuity that landing bay X23 was not the site of the rendezvous between Vago and the individuals due to meet with Popara.<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> depicted in ''Tempest Feud''.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
